request.prompt:
Deliverable: landscape flat decision-routing infographic for a Chinese AI engineering article.
Primary request: show how a Jev decision and confidence can be routed into automation, model review, or human review. Make clear that the thresholds are an example design, not an official default.
Composition: left card "Jev 决策 + 置信度" feeds three horizontal threshold lanes. Top green lane: ">0.90 直接执行" leading to "自动化". Middle beige lane: "0.70–0.90 大模型复核" leading to "复核". Bottom coral lane: "<0.70 转人工" leading to "人工". A large bottom card reads "可审计边界：机器决定 vs 需人看" and a small note reads "示例阈值，需用业务数据标定".
Style and medium: flat technical editorial infographic, warm paper background, teal green / beige / coral lanes, dark hand-drawn arrows, clear hierarchy, no 3D, no photorealism.
Text (exact): Allowed readable text only: "置信度分级路由：90 / 70 / 阈值分流", "Jev 决策 + 置信度", ">0.90 直接执行", "自动化", "0.70–0.90 大模型复核", "复核", "<0.70 转人工", "人工", "可审计边界：机器决定 vs 需人看", and "示例阈值，需用业务数据标定". Render each exactly once. No other readable text.
Avoid: extra words, duplicated labels, misspellings, implying these thresholds are official, watermark.
